description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the HTTP behaviour of the Gateway service in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for supported schema versions, HTTPS enforcement and redirection, CORS, request timeout, header definitions from query parameters, accepted media types, and a nested enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: HttpConfig.GatewayHttpConfigValue
classes.description: An enum representing default configuration path expressions and their default values for the HttpConfig interface in the Gateway service.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the set of JSON schema versions supported by the API Gateway.

methods.name: isForceHttps
methods.description: Indicates whether HTTPS enforcement is enabled.

methods.name: isRedirectToHttps
methods.description: Indicates whether redirection from HTTP to HTTPS is enabled.

methods.name: getRedirectToHttpsBlocklistPattern
methods.description: Returns the pattern for paths that should not be redirected to HTTPS even if redirection is enabled.

methods.name: isEnableCors
methods.description: Indicates whether Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) is enabled.

methods.name: getRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration of the request timeout.

methods.name: getActorPropsFactoryFullQualifiedClassname
methods.description: Returns the class name for the HttpRequestActorPropsFactory implementation.

methods.name: getQueryParametersAsHeaders
methods.description: Returns header definitions that should be derived from query parameters.

methods.name: getAdditionalAcceptedMediaTypes
methods.description: Returns additional media types accepted by endpoints besides the primary types.
